title: Wowza Streaming Engine before 4.12.2 processes XML external entities, which allows remote attackers to read local…
description: Wowza Streaming Engine versions before 4.12.2 are vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) processing. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to read local files on the server with the privileges of the Wowza Streaming Engine process. The flaw arises from improper handling of XML input, enabling unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information.
